chapter.verse: Ni nga khit ciangin Jew makai kimkhat leh thukhen zum tamsi Tertullus tawh kithuahin siampi lianpenpa Ananias hong paisuk a, gam-uk mangpa' mai-ah Paul khia-in thu bawl uh hi.

Paul a kisap khit ciangin Tertullus in hih bangin mawhsakna thu sung hi: “Zahtak-huai Felix mangpa aw, nangma' hangin nopna lemna nakpi ka ngah uh a, nang' thumuhna tawh hih gam ah puahphatnate zong kibawlbawl ahih manin
Felix mangpa aw, mun citeng ah ka vekun lungdamna sangpen tawh hih thu ka phawk uh hi.
Ahi zongin saupi hong dongtangsak ka hihloh nadingun ka thugen uh nong hehpihna tawh tawmvei nong ngaihsak nading kong thum uh hi.
Hih mipa pen thusia phuang, leitung mun citeng ah Jew mi khempeuh a buai nadinga a sosuah, upna pial pawl ahi Nazarene mite a makaih khat ahihlam ka mukhia uh hi.
Biakinnpi nangawn thaangbawl sawm a, ahi zongin amah ka man uh hi. (Komau' thukhun a om bangin amah thu ka khen nuam uh hi.
Ahih hangin galkap mangpa Lysias hong pai-in ngongtatna lianpi tawh kote' khutsung pan amah kaikhia a,
amah a mawhsakte nang' kiangah hong pai nadingun thupia hi.) Amah ka mawhsak thute khempeuh nangmahmah ii dottel tawh ama' tungpan na theikhia zo ding hi,” ci hi.
Jew mite in zong mawhsak thusunna panpih uh a, hih thute khempeuh maan hi ci-in dinpih uh hi.

Gam-uk mangpa in Paul' lamah a lu pikin thugen ding a sawl ciangin Paul in hih bangin gen hi: “Kum tampi sung hih gam ah thukhen mang na sep lam hong thei ka hih manin mawhloh lahtelna thu lungnuamtak kong sung ding hi.
Nangmahmah in na theihkhak ding mah bangin Jerusalem ah Pasian bia dinga ka paitoh pen ni sawmlenih val nailo hi.
Biakinnpi sung ahi-a vengkhawm inn sung leh khuapi sung ahi zongin mi khatpeuh tawh ka kinial lam, ahihkeileh mihonpi ka sosuah lam amaute in hong mu lo uh hi.
Tu-in zong kei hong mawhsakna thute nang' kiangah siksan teci hong lak thei tuanlo ding uh hi.

Ahih hangin kei' kong pulaknop thu ahihleh (amaute in upna pial pawlke a cih uh) Lampi thu tawh kituakin komau' pupite' Pasian a bia ka hi a, Thukhun Laibu sunga kikhungte leh Kamsang Laibu sunga kigelhte a vekin ka um hi.
Midikte leh midiklote a nam nihin thawhkikna om ding cih (hih mite mahmah in zong a up a san uh) lametna, Pasian' sungah ka nei hi.
Tua hi a, Pasian' mai leh mite' mai-ah kitheihtawmna lungsim siangtho ka neih nading ka hanciam den hi.
Kum tampi khit, tu-in ka mipihte' tungah citpiak huhna a puak dingin leh Pasian' kiangah biakpiak van a luui dingin ka pai hi.
Tua bang ka sep laitak, amaute in biakinnpi sunga ka kisiansuah hong mu uh a, mihonpi leh gamlumna cih bang om lo hi.
Ahi zongin Asia gam pana hong pai Jew kimkhat in kei mawhsak nading thu a neih uhleh hih mun ah hong pai-in nangma' mai-ah thubawlna a neih ding uh kilawm hi.
Tua bang ahih keileh zong Jew makaipawl mai ka din lai-in bang khutkhialhna nei ka hiam hih mite mahmah gensak in.
Amaute' mai ka din lai-in, ‘Tuni-a no teng' mai-ah thusit ka thuakna pen misite' thawhkik ding ka lametna hang ahi hi,’ ci-in ka kikokhia a, tua longal ka hih dang om lo hi.”
Ahih hangin Lampi Thu teltak a thei khat ahi Felix in, “Tul-uk mangpa Lysias hong tunsuk ciangin na thu uh kong khensak ding hi,” ci-in thudotna khiinto hi.
Tua ciangin galkap za-uk bupa' kiangah Paul, galkap cinna tawh kemin suahtakna a kilawm ciang khat a piak nading leh ama' kisap bang a don nuam a lawmte kuamah a khaktan loh nadingin thupia hi.
A sawt lo-in Felix zong Jew minam a zi Drusilla tawh hong pai-in Paul samsak a, Khris Jesu upna thu Paul' genna ngai uh hi.
Dikna thu, pumpi ki-ukzawhna thu, hong tung ding thukhenna thu, cihte a kuppih ciangin Felix patau a, “Tu tadih paikhia phot in. Hunpha ka ngah ciangin kong samsak ding hi,” ci hi.
Tua kawm mahin Paul' kiangpan sum ngah ding lamen ahih manin Paul samsak zelzelin amah tawh kiho thei zel hi.
Kum nih a cin ciangin Felix pen Porcius Festus in zalaih hi. Felix in Jew mite maipha pia nuam ahih manin Paul thong sungah nusiatsan hi.Caesar' kiangah Thumbehna
